analysis.company_profile: IQVIA provides data, analytics, and technology solutions to pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare organizations worldwide.

candidate_positioning: A senior AI engineer with proven end‑to‑end GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI delivery in healthcare and telecom, ready to lead production‑grade AI solutions for IQVIA’s commercial analytics teams.

team_needs.need: Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI/GenAI/agentic solutions
team_needs.evidence: Optum: LangGraph‑based analytics system; Viavi: RAG Project Discovery Assistant; SLA breach prediction system with FastAPI + MLflow
team_needs.gap: No explicit mention of large‑scale rollout across multiple IQVIA markets.

team_needs.need: Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
team_needs.evidence: Viavi: 30+ AI prototypes for client use‑cases; Optum: lab extraction agent automating 800 Jira tickets

team_needs.need: Build intelligent workflows using models, LLMs, APIs, and agentic frameworks
team_needs.evidence: LangGraph‑based analytics; multi‑agent RFP automation platform; FastAPI services for SLA prediction
team_needs.gap: Limited exposure to specific IQVIA enterprise APIs.

team_needs.need: Develop RAG, semantic search, knowledge discovery solutions
team_needs.evidence: Cross‑encoder training for dense retrieval (AARP data); RAG Project Discovery Assistant; vector DB experience (pgvector)
team_needs.gap: No experience with commercial vector stores like Pinecone/Weaviate, though concepts are covered.

team_needs.need: Define evaluation approaches for quality, performance, impact, risk
team_needs.evidence: Automated evaluation and observability pipelines for QA and Summary agents; LLM evaluators, tracing, failure detection
team_needs.gap: Governance and compliance evaluation frameworks not explicitly listed.

team_needs.need: Transform POCs into reusable, production‑ready capabilities
team_needs.evidence: Production SLA breach prediction system with MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes; LangGraph analytics moved to production at Optum

team_needs.need: Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms, data sources, cloud
team_needs.evidence: Integration with LIMS using Claude & Textract; FastAPI APIs; cloud experience (GCP, Azure); Elasticsearch observability
team_needs.gap: Specific IQVIA platform integrations not demonstrated.

team_needs.need: Apply MLOps/LLMOps, security, governance, documentation best practices
team_needs.evidence: MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Airflow; automated observability pipelines
team_needs.gap: Explicit LLMOps tooling and formal AI governance/compliance processes not highlighted.

project.name: Clinical Knowledge Retrieval Assistant
project.problem: Clinicians and commercial analysts need fast, accurate answers from IQVIA’s massive structured and unstructured healthcare datasets while meeting regulatory and governance standards.
project.approach: Create a LangGraph‑orchestrated multi‑agent pipeline: (1) query intent detection, (2) semantic retrieval from a pgvector store populated via ETL of IQVIA data, (3) cross‑encoder re‑ranking, (4) LLM (Claude/OpenAI) synthesis with prompt engineering, (5) automated evaluation using LLM evaluators and risk scoring, (6) deployment via FastAPI behind API gateway, managed with MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and integrated with IQVIA’s enterprise authentication and audit logging. Include governance hooks for model versioning, bias checks, and compliance reporting.

requirements_not_covered: Explicit experience with formal AI governance, compliance, and risk‑management frameworks
Demonstrated LLMOps tooling beyond general MLOps (e.g., specialized prompt‑store or model‑registry for LLMs)
Direct experience with IQVIA’s proprietary enterprise platforms or APIs
